name: Algolia Search
description: Provides integration with the Algolia search engine
project_description:
This module enables integration with Algolia by leveraging Drupal's Search API .

 Please note that this module only supports indexing. The search interface may be implemented on the front-end using the Algolia Javascript API. 

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 
 Search API 
 Algolia search client PHP library 
 An account on https://www.algolia.com
